posts.body_html:
I made a pretty bold claim that S. leucophylla var. alba 'original chamelon' Baldwin Co, AL is perhaps one of the whitest clones in the collection, it's just hard as EF to get it to color up! That probably fell on deaf ears but now that I have some updated pics, maybe some of you might start believing me!

Here's the clone in 2020, looks like a glorified Hurricane creek white:


and now here's the exact same clone photographed on 10/1/24! I couldn't look any more different, except look at the shape of the mouth, they're identical in both pictures! The pitcher is blemished because we had a week of cold, foggy mornings, but I think you can get the big picture of things here:




The solid white coloration stretches further down the trap than expected:
